connectorUiConfig.title: Netskope Web Transactions (via Blob Storage)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The Netskope Web Transactions data connector enables ingestion of web transaction logs from Netskope into Microsoft Sentinel using Netskope Log Streaming (NLS) capability. Web transaction logs provide detailed visibility into all web traffic processed by Netskope, including user activity, application usage, URL categories, policy actions, and network metadata.

This connector uses Azure Blob Storage and Event Grid to ingest logs that Netskope streams to your storage account.

sampleQueries.description: Get Sample of Netskope WebTx Logs

sampleQueries.query: NetskopeWebTransactions_CL | summarize TotalBytes = sum(Bytes) by CsUsername | top 10 by TotalBytes
NetskopeWebTransactions_CL | where isnotempty(XCsApp) | summarize Count = count() by XCsApp | top 10 by Count

dataTypes.name: NetskopeWebTransactions_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
NetskopeWebTransactions_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(12h)
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.
Read permissions to shared keys for the workspace are required.

customs.name: Subscription permissions
customs.description: Contributor permissions are required on the target resource group to deploy storage queues and Event Grid resources. Owner or User Access Administrator permissions are required on the storage account when creating the Event Grid sender role assignment. The Microsoft.EventGrid resource provider must be registered in the storage account subscription.

customs.name: Microsoft Sentinel collector permissions
customs.description: By connecting, the Microsoft Sentinel first-party enterprise application displayed below Connection Configuration is granted Storage Blob Data Reader and Storage Queue Data Contributor on the blob container and queues. These permissions allow the collector to read Netskope blobs and process the notification and dead-letter queues.

customs.name: Event Grid delivery identity
customs.description: The Event Grid system topic uses its own system-assigned managed identity to send BlobCreated notifications to the queue. Choose Create to grant it Storage Queue Data Message Sender at storage-account scope, or Use existing only if that exact topic identity already has the role.

customs.name: Netskope Log Streaming Configuration
customs.description: Configure Netskope Log Streaming (NLS) to send Web Transaction logs to your Azure Blob Storage container. Follow the [Netskope NLS documentation](https://docs.netskope.com/en/log-streaming) for setup instructions.

instructionSteps.title: Connect Netskope Web Transaction Logs to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
To enable the Netskope Web Transactions Logs for Microsoft Sentinel, provide the required information below and click on Connect.

**Prerequisites:**
1. Configure Netskope NLS to send Web Transaction logs to an Azure Blob Storage container
2. Ensure you have the required permissions on the storage account

parameters.label: Blob Folder Name (Optional)
parameters.placeholder: Leave empty if logs are at container root
parameters.name: blobFolderName

parameters.label: Event Grid Topic Name (if exists)
parameters.description: The data flow uses Event Grid to send 'blob-created event' notifications. There can be only one Event Grid topic per storage account. Go to your storage account's 'Events' section. If you already have a topic, provide its name. Otherwise, leave empty to create a new one.
parameters.placeholder: Leave empty to create new topic
parameters.name: EGSystemTopicName

parameters.text: Only one Event Grid system topic can exist per storage account. If one exists, enter its exact name. The connector preserves existing tags and identities while enabling system-assigned identity. Otherwise, leave empty to create a topic.

parameters.title: Event Grid Storage Queue Data Message Sender assignment
parameters.name: eventGridRbacMode

options.label: Create the required storage-account role assignment
Use an existing storage-account role assignment

parameters.content:
Choose **Create** for a new topic, a newly enabled system-assigned identity, or when that identity lacks **Storage Queue Data Message Sender** on the storage account. **Use existing** skips that grant; it does not discover or repair permissions. The collector's blob and queue grants are still deployed.

If Connect fails with **Managed Identity Authorization Error**, wait about five minutes and retry with the same values. RBAC propagation can take up to ten minutes.
